name: Magister’s Channel Energy
body:
Your ties to divine energy have granted you the ability to channel energy.

Prerequisite: Magister 5, 9 or more spells known from the cleric spell list.

Benefit: You gain the supernatural ability to channel positive energy like a cleric. Your effective cleric level for channeling energy is your magister level –4. This is a Charisma-based ability.
